script = '''
import json
from docx import Document
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, Table, TableStyle
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.lib import colors
from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_LEFT, TA_CENTER

doc = Document("docs/customer_report.docx")

# Extract all text content
paragraphs_data = []
tables_data = []

for element in doc.element.body:
    tag = element.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in element.tag else element.tag
    if tag == "p":
        # Find the matching paragraph object
        for p in doc.paragraphs:
            if p._element is element:
                paragraphs_data.append({
                    "text": p.text,
                    "style": p.style.name if p.style else "Normal",
                    "type": "paragraph"
                })
                break
    elif tag == "tbl":
        for t in doc.tables:
            if t._element is element:
                rows = []
                for row in t.rows:
                    rows.append([cell.text for cell in row.cells])
                tables_data.append(rows)
                paragraphs_data.append({"type": "table", "index": len(tables_data) - 1})
                break

# Build PDF
pdf_path = "docs/customer_report.pdf"
pdf_doc = SimpleDocTemplate(pdf_path, pagesize=letter,
                            leftMargin=0.75*inch, rightMargin=0.75*inch,
                            topMargin=0.75*inch, bottomMargin=0.75*inch)

styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
styles.add(ParagraphStyle(name="DocTitle", parent=styles["Title"], fontSize=16, spaceAfter=12))
styles.add(ParagraphStyle(name="DocHeading1", parent=styles["Heading1"], fontSize=14, spaceAfter=8))
styles.add(ParagraphStyle(name="DocHeading2", parent=styles["Heading2"], fontSize=12, spaceAfter=6))
styles.add(ParagraphStyle(name="DocNormal", parent=styles["Normal"], fontSize=10, spaceAfter=4, leading=14))

story = []

for item in paragraphs_data:
    if item["type"] == "table":
        idx = item["index"]
        tdata = tables_data[idx]
        if not tdata:
            continue
        # Build table
        t = Table(tdata, repeatRows=1)
        style_cmds = [
            ("BACKGROUND", (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.HexColor("#4472C4")),
            ("TEXTCOLOR", (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.white),
            ("FONTNAME", (0, 0), (-1, 0), "Helvetica-Bold"),
            ("FONTSIZE", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 9),
            ("ALIGN", (0, 0), (-1, -1), "LEFT"),
            ("GRID", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, colors.grey),
            ("ROWBACKGROUNDS", (0, 1), (-1, -1), [colors.white, colors.HexColor("#D9E2F3")]),
            ("VALIGN", (0, 0), (-1, -1), "MIDDLE"),
            ("TOPPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 4),
            ("BOTTOMPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 4),
        ]
        t.setStyle(TableStyle(style_cmds))
        story.append(t)
        story.append(Spacer(1, 12))
    else:
        text = item["text"].strip()
        if not text:
            story.append(Spacer(1, 6))
            continue
        style_name = item.get("style", "Normal")
        if "Title" in style_name:
            story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["DocTitle"]))
        elif "Heading 1" in style_name or style_name == "Heading1":
            story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["DocHeading1"]))
        elif "Heading" in style_name:
            story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["DocHeading2"]))
        else:
            story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["DocNormal"]))

if not story:
    story.append(Paragraph("(Empty document)", styles["DocNormal"]))

pdf_doc.build(story)
print(f"PDF created at {pdf_path}")
'''
await write_file("./convert_docx_to_pdf.py", script)

email_script = '''
import smtplib
import os
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

sender = "agent@example.com"
recipient = "bob@example.com"
subject = "Customer Activity Report - Maya Chen"
body = """Hi Bob,

Please find attached the customer activity report for Maya Chen. The report includes order ORD-6C71B1 from 2026-09-02 with a total of $79.

Best regards"""

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg["From"] = sender
msg["To"] = recipient
msg["Subject"] = subject

pdf_path = "docs/customer_report.pdf"
with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
    part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
    part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header("Content-Disposition", f"attachment; filename=customer_report.pdf")
    msg.attach(part)

# Try localhost SMTP (common in sandbox environments)
try:
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as server:
        server.sendmail(sender, recipient, msg.as_string())
    print("Email sent successfully via localhost:25")
except Exception as e1:
    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 1025) as server:
            server.sendmail(sender, recipient, msg.as_string())
        print("Email sent successfully via localhost:1025")
    except Exception as e2:
        try:
            with smtplib.SMTP("mailhog", 1025) as server:
                server.sendmail(sender, recipient, msg.as_string())
            print("Email sent successfully via mailhog:1025")
        except Exception as e3:
            print(f"Failed all SMTP attempts: localhost:25={e1}, localhost:1025={e2}, mailhog:1025={e3}")
'''
